base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) FROM (
  SELECT m.XCL_010, COUNT(b.XCL_004) AS single_bond_count
  FROM molecule m
  INNER JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
  INNER JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
  WHERE m.XCL_011 = '-'
    AND a.XCL_003 IN ('na', 'ca')
    AND b.XCL_006 = '-'
  GROUP BY m.XCL_010
) AS subquery

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) AS avg_single_bonds
FROM (
    SELECT m.XCL_010, COUNT(b.XCL_004) AS single_bond_count
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
    JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    JOIN connected c ON b.XCL_004 = c.XCL_009
    WHERE m.XCL_011 = 'non-carcinogenic'
      AND (a.XCL_003 = 'Na' OR a.XCL_003 = 'Ca')
      AND c.XCL_008 = 'S'
    GROUP BY m.XCL_010
)
